definitions.explanation: A belief that something will happen or be the case.

examples.japanese: {期待|きたい}⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to it. / I have high hopes.

examples.japanese: {期待|きたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}える→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧。
{期待|きたい}⟦はずれ→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{期待|きたい} means expectation or hope — anticipating something positive will happen. Can function as a noun or する verb.

Transitivity:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期待|きたい}する

Common patterns:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期待|きたい}する: to expect ~, to hope for ~
- {期待|きたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}える→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧: to meet/live up to expectations
- {期待|きたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧: to betray expectations
- {期待|きたい}はずれ: disappointment, letdown
- {期待|きたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧: expectations rise

Common expressions:
- {期待|きたい}しています: I'm looking forward to it
- ご{期待|きたい}ください: Please look forward to it (promotional)
- {期待|きたい}どおり: as expected

Contrast:
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧: expectation — more neutral, can be positive or negative

Aspect (ている):
- [X]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期待|きたい}している: is looking forward to / hopes for X (stative — describes an ongoing feeling of anticipation)
- {期待|きたい}していない: does not expect, has no hopes for
- {期待|きたい}する describes a mental/emotional state of anticipation. The ている form is the default way to describe the ongoing hope. {期待|きたい}しています (polite) is a set expression meaning "I'm looking forward to it."
